alt: First two pages of L.A. Care's official grievance resolution letter dated July 9, 2026, resolving the June 12, 2026 transportation grievance, which was backdated to appear compliant with the 30-day statutory deadline.
full_text: L.A. Care Health Plan. July 09, 2026. NICOLAS HERNANDEZ. Reference Number: REDACTED. June 12, 2026. Regarding: Quality-of-Service. Dear NICOLAS HERNANDEZ, Thank you for bringing your concern(s) to our attention. L.A. Care Health Plan received your grievance on June 12, 2026. Concern/s: 1. You filed a complaint against Call the Car regarding transportation services. You advised L.A. Care that you attempted to schedule transportation for March 16, 2026, to travel to your local pharmacy. 2. You stated that you experienced extended wait times, which resulted in a delay in obtaining your time-sensitive medications. Resolution: L.A. Care Health Plan would like to begin by extending our sincere apology for any inconvenience you may have experienced. We are committed to providing our members with timely access to quality care and services. To review your concern, L.A. Care contacted Call the Car (CTC) and obtained information regarding your transportation request. CTC advised that your request for transportation was received on March 15, 2026, at 11:40 p.m. An Uber driver arrived at the designated pick-up location at 12:21 a.m., and the trip was completed at 12:33 a.m. Please be advised that, in accordance with L.A. Care's transportation policy, members are required to schedule transportation reservations at least two (2) business days in advance to ensure availability. For same-day transportation requests, members must contact CTC at least three (3) hours before the requested pick-up time. Quava Anderson, Appeals & Grievances Specialist, Grievances and Appeals Department, L.A. Care Health Plan.
summary: First two pages of L.A. Care's official grievance resolution letter regarding the June 12, 2026 transportation complaints. Although dated July 9, 2026, to fabricate compliance with the 30-day Knox-Keene statutory deadline, USPS Informed Delivery records prove that this letter was only mailed on July 18, 2026—six days after the plan had legally defaulted.
